create_class_generalizedpcfg: create a GeneralizedPCFG distribution with preterminal scores, root scores, and binary/unary rule scores for conditional tree parsing
create_class_pcfg: create a PCFG distribution from word emission probabilities, word IDs, root scores, and grammar rules for constituency parsing
run_structure_forward: run the CKY-style forward pass over a sentence using semiring arithmetic to compute parse probabilities
get_event_shape: get the event shape describing chart and preterminal tensor dimensions for a given PCFG instance
get_batch_shape: get the batch shape of the PCFG distribution from its rule tensor dimensions
